dct_description_sm: Map shows Delaware River and Timber River or Big Timber Creek through the borough of Westville.

Map shows the West Jersey Sand Gravel properties and William Cunningham's properties along the Timber River. Map also shows Groves Cut Off which was dredged in 1909 by a private party on Timber River in Westville Borough.
